note: Conformance vectors for ADR 0154's node plans and core's own rights over a node: each kind's header order (`kinds`), a node header's plan (`header`: the rights its page and core grant, the kind's order, the page's own entries and, on an app, how many buttons fit (`maxButtons`, absent: all) -> buttons, the menu, the menu's last group), a level row's menu (`row`: rights and own entries -> the menu and its last group), and core's favourite, cover and bookmark rights (`rights`, every combination of their inputs). Entries are `HeaderAction`'s serial names. Each case names its rule (`rule`). Inputs chosen by hand; every `expected` first recorded from the web's TypeScript, where it can express the case, and read against its rule before commit.

header.rule: a member's folder: core's around the standard ones, in the kind's order
a Memory: its page's upload, banner and music among them; the banner in the last group
a Memory whose banner is drawn already: no banner entry
a file: its replace beside the share
a kept link that reads: its own page first, its name's report then its share's, the delete last
a kept link whose link does not read: its name's report alone
a kept link on an instance that takes no report: its share's report still
a READ guest's folder: the download and the report
a READ_WRITE guest's folder: the move too
a space pending deletion: what reads, and the share (listing links is a read)
a space's top level: no node, no order
an order lists the actions it names first, every other one follows in the merge order
an app's folder: rename, cover and "Available offline" in the menu, two buttons fit
a phone's file: send in the menu, three buttons fit
no button fits: every one in the menu, in order, the last group apart

row.rule: a folder's row: rename and move first, core's after the heart and the cover, report and delete last
a kept link's row that reads: its share's report after its name's
a READ_WRITE guest's row: the move, the download, the report
an app's row: the share among the standard ones
an app's row of a node kept offline
